They’ll Hang You for That Face

name: They’ll Hang You for That Face
storyline:
Living in an isolated freezing village, you are a hated woodcutter whose only emotional support is your wife and son. One day, during a "Werewolf Trial," you are framed for all crimes by a malicious conspiracy.

Execution is set for tomorrow morning.

If you do nothing, your beloved family will be slaughtered as accomplices. To let them escape, you choose to become the scapegoat, burning at the stake as the unloved "Werewolf". —But after death, a horrific scene unfolds before your spirit. You witness your surviving family become toys for the mastermind, hopelessly broken.

"I... I have to save them...!" Your overwhelming regret warps time itself, and you wake up again in the prison on the eve of execution. Beside you, the ghost of a medium watches and sneers. The ultimate choice.

A blood-stained loop. Can you find the true path to let your loved ones escape safely, even if it means sacrificing yourself?
summary: Tomorrow, you burn at the stake as a "Werewolf". To save your family, you gladly accept a false execution. But after death, you witness them being ravaged in a living hell. Through a time loop triggered by your absolute despair, you must weave the world's kindest lie.
